prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a single wide 16:9 background plate for a handcrafted felt story animation, requested 2048 x 1152.
Primary request: A cozy Dutch colonial farmhouse living room in New York around 1790, designed as a miniature needle-felt theatrical diorama. One continuous room, not a collage.
Composition: eye-height camera, broad frontal stage view. Stone fireplace at the far left with gentle felt flame glow. Rough timber ceiling beams and plaster wool walls. A candle chandelier. A small back-right window shows blue dusk. A wooden feast table in the back-left holds small pies and cakes. Keep a LARGE EMPTY CONTINUOUS WOOD PLANK FLOOR across the whole center and foreground for animated characters to stand and dance on, with its usable standing area at 75–85% of image height. No foreground objects obscuring the floor.
Style: beautifully crafted children's storybook needle-felt wool diorama, visible fuzzy fibers and stitched details, sculpted soft felt trees visible outside, restrained handmade detail. Everything—including wood and stone—is visibly handmade fabric and wool. No realistic photograph.
Lighting: warm amber candles and fire, readable warm brown/cream palette, gentle cinematic depth, darker blue twilight in window. Calm inviting room.
Constraints: NO people, NO animals, NO human figures, NO characters, NO text, NO lettering, NO logos, NO watermark, NO border, NO collage, NO modern objects. Avoid heavy perspective convergence or a central foreground table. The background itself is still. Output one complete landscape image.
edit_prompt: Edit this felt farmhouse interior background for an AUTUMN Sleepy Hollow story. Preserve the exact image composition, handcrafted wool texture, warm fire and candlelight, timber/plaster colonial room, fireplace on the left, pies on the back-left feast table, blue dusk window at right, and the large empty continuous wooden floor. Remove all Christmas-looking decoration: remove holly leaves and red berries from the fireplace mantel, chandelier and window; replace with plain undecorated wood/metal surfaces, with at most a small simple dry autumn branch arrangement on the mantel. Outside the window show autumn dusk with dark leafy trees and russet-brown ground; remove any snow and wintery white patches. Keep the candles lit, and everything else identical. No people, animals, text, logos, border, or collage. Preserve wide 16:9 composition.
inspection: Generated results inspected visually: single warm felt room, empty continuous floor, fireplace left, feast table back left, autumn dusk window right, no people animals or text. Initial Christmas-looking berries and winter window were removed with a built-in image_gen edit. Final autumn result copied unchanged.
